label: BatteryMaintenanceConfig
info:
Battery Maintenance Config State - Read/Write

Registers:
- 003-007: Serial Number (Read Only)
- 211: Battery control mode (R/W) 0=voltage, 1=capacity, 2=no battery
- 212: Lithium battery wake up (R/W) 0=enabled, 1=disabled
- 213: Battery resistance mΩ (R/W)
- 214: Charge efficiency 0.1% (R/W)
